paragraphs.text: Tamar was Absalom's sister both by father and mother, and Amnon's only by father.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: And therefore kept her father's house, as virgins were accustomed.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Here we see that there is no enterprise so wicked that it cannot be encouraged to further wickedness.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: Lay thee down on thy bed

paragraphs.text: Meaning, some delicate and dainty meat.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: That is, she served them on a dish.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: For the wicked are ashamed to do that before men, which they are not afraid to commit in the sight of God.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: As a lewd and wicked person.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: For that which was of various colours or pieces, in those days was greatly esteemed, Ge 37:3, Jud 5:30.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: For though he conceived sudden vengeance in his heart, yet he concealed it till an opportunity arose, and comforted his sister.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: That is, to a banquet, thinking by it to fulfil his wicked purpose.
paragraphs.label: k
paragraphs.anchor: Absalom invited all the king's sons

paragraphs.text: Pretending to the king that Amnon was most dear to him.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: Such is the pride of the wicked masters, that in all their wicked commandments they think to be obeyed.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: Lamenting, as he that felt the wrath of God on his house, 2Sa 12:10.
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: For Maachah his mother was the daughter of this Talmai, 2Sa 3:3.
